tldr: 台股三面向利多齊發、目標價步步高，挑戰 42,000 點；MSCI 半年度調整 5/13 公布、美國 4 月 CPI 週二登場為下一波關鍵變數。
台積電大訊息週：4 月營收 4,107 億元年增 17.5%、與 Sony 簽 MOU 合資研發次世代影像感測器、奪蘋果數據機晶片大單、4/5 奈米產能由超微接手智慧手機客戶釋出空檔。
金融三業首季稅前獲利 3,709.97 億元創同期新高、年增 37%；彭金隆下鄉視察高雄亞資專區 56 家進駐、AUM 邁向 2.4 兆元。
Fed 換手戲碼登場：參議院本週表決華許接任案、高盛把首次降息推遲至 2026 年底；芝加哥聯準銀總裁古爾斯比警告 AI 不論成敗都將推升通膨。
政院跨部會就「連續受益人信託」課稅達共識，僅於信託成立時課一次遺贈稅，為跨世代家族信託開門；渣打在台首推保單融資、再與凱雷推私募股權基金搶攻高資產。

items.title_zh: 三面向利多助攻 台股目標價步步高
items.title_en: Triple tailwind drives TAIEX target prices higher
items.summary_zh: 基本面、資金面、技術面三利多齊發，法人持續上調年底目標價至 45,000–50,000 點。美股科技股創高、超微、安謀、輝達、英特爾執行長 5 月下旬陸續來台 (COMPUTEX 2026)，台指期夜盤週日已上漲至 42,292 點，今日現股將挑戰 42,000 點。聯發科被列「處置股」議題仍存風險，但成交量逾兆元、漲勢結構仍偏多。
items.summary_en: Fundamentals, liquidity, and technicals are reinforcing each other as analysts lift the year-end target band to 45,000–50,000 points. Friday's record close on US tech, plus a string of CEO visits (AMD, Arm, Nvidia, Intel) ahead of COMPUTEX 2026, has Taiex futures night-session printing 42,292 on Sunday and bulls eyeing 42,000 on the cash open. The MediaTek/TSMC "watchlist stock" controversy keeps headline risk live, but breadth and turnover (over NT$1 tn daily) still favor the upside.

items.title_zh: MSCI 半年度調整 台股權重有望提升
items.title_en: MSCI semi-annual rebalance Friday — Taiwan likely to gain weight
items.summary_zh: MSCI 將於 5/13 凌晨 (台北時間) 公布半年度調整名單、5/29 盤後生效。三大機構押寶南亞科、南電等九檔台股有望入列；受惠台積電首季漲 13.5%、半導體強勢，台灣在 MSCI EM 與 AC World 指數權重有望同步上修。
items.summary_en: MSCI announces its May review at 5/13 dawn (Taipei) with the changes effective post-close 5/29. Brokers widely flag South Asia DRAM (Nanya), Nanya PCB, and roughly nine candidates as likely additions, given the 13.5% Q1 rally in TSMC and broader semiconductor strength has lifted Taiwan's relative weight in MSCI EM and AC World indices.

items.title_zh: 聯發科處置股風波 金管會承諾一個月內修法
items.title_en: MediaTek "watchlist stock" episode forces FSC to redraft rules
items.summary_zh: 聯發科股價漲幅觸發警示成為首檔市值逾 5 兆元的處置股；立委質疑現行制度停留在十年前水準（台積電權重 43% 反不會被處分、聯發科僅 3.3% 卻遭處置），主委彭金隆證實已研議排除條款、一個月內提報告。
items.summary_en: MediaTek became the first NT$5 tn-plus market cap stock placed on the exchange watchlist after a rally-triggered warning. Lawmakers slammed the rule for being calibrated to the pre-TSMC-dominance era (TSMC's 43% index weight doesn't trigger sanctions but MediaTek's 3.3% does); FSC chair Peng Jin-lung promised exclusion-clause amendments within one month.

items.title_zh: 巴菲特指標飆 500% 彭金隆：股市終將回歸基本面
items.title_en: Buffett Indicator at 500% — chair says "fundamentals will prevail"
items.summary_zh: 台股突破 42,000 點之際，外媒警告巴菲特指標（市值／GDP）逼近 500%「玩火」水位；金管會主委彭金隆強調台灣產業具國際競爭力、股市非無基本面支撐，市場「終將回歸基本面」而非靠人為干預。
items.summary_en: With TAIEX recently piercing 42,000, foreign media flag the Buffett Indicator (market cap / GDP) near 500%, calling it "playing with fire". FSC chair Peng Jin-lung counters that Taiwan's industrial competitiveness is internationally peer-leading and the market is not detached from earnings; he reiterated stocks "will eventually return to fundamentals" rather than retreat to systemic intervention.

items.title_zh: 台積電 4 月營收 4,107 億元年增 17.5% 創歷史次高
items.title_en: TSMC books NT$410.7 bn April revenue — record second-highest single month
items.summary_zh: 台積電 4 月營收 4,107.26 億元、月減 1.1% 但年增 17.5%；累計前 4 月營收 1 兆 5,448 億元、年增 29.9%。先進製程與先進封裝需求強勁，5、6 月營收有機會再創單月新高。
items.summary_en: TSMC posted April revenue of NT$410.726 bn, down 1.1% MoM but up 17.5% YoY, with cumulative 4M revenue of NT$1.5448 tn (+29.9% YoY). Advanced nodes and advanced packaging demand remained robust; management hinted May/June could set fresh single-month records on AI accelerator pull-in.

items.title_zh: 台積電與 Sony 合資設廠 攻次世代影像感測器
items.title_en: TSMC and Sony sign MOU to set up next-gen image sensor JV
items.summary_zh: 雙方簽署不具約束力 MOU、由 Sony 持多數股權及控制權，在日本熊本縣合志市新廠房研發次世代 CMOS 影像感測器，並探索實體 AI 在汽車與機器人領域應用，為台積電 JASM 之外的日本布局延伸。
items.summary_en: TSMC and Sony signed a non-binding MOU to form a joint venture (Sony to hold majority equity and operating control) operating from a new plant in Koshi, Kumamoto, Japan, focused on next-generation CMOS image sensors and exploring physical-AI applications in automotive and robotics — a strategic extension of TSMC's Japan footprint beyond JASM.

items.title_zh: 台積電 4、5 奈米產能 超微趁機接手
items.title_en: TSMC's 4/5 nm slots: AMD steps in as smartphone customers retreat
items.summary_zh: 智慧手機需求走緩使高通、聯發科縮減投片，台積電釋出的先進產能改由超微接手用於 AI 晶片，形成供應鏈蝴蝶效應。產能利用率維持滿載，但客戶組合明顯向 AI 基建轉移。
items.summary_en: Softening smartphone demand has Qualcomm and MediaTek trimming 4/5 nm wafer starts; AMD is absorbing the freed-up capacity for AI accelerators, producing a butterfly effect across the supply chain. The reshuffle keeps utilization tight while shifting the customer mix decisively toward AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: 台積電奪蘋果數據機晶片代工大單
items.title_en: TSMC wins Apple modem chip foundry order
items.summary_zh: 蘋果將數據機晶片代工訂單交付台積電，延伸蘋果自研晶片計畫至蜂巢式基頻，並在 M 系列與 A 系列之外，為台積電最先進製程鎖定另一高量級客戶。
items.summary_en: Apple has placed its modem chip foundry business with TSMC, extending Apple's silicon insourcing program to cellular baseband and locking in another high-volume A-list customer for TSMC's most advanced nodes alongside the M-series and A-series.

items.title_zh: ABF 載板下半年漲價、南電目標價挑戰千金
items.title_en: ABF substrates: South Asian PCBA tightens, prices to rise into H2 / Nan Ya PCB target raised toward NT$1,000
items.summary_zh: AI 伺服器拉貨拉長 ABF 載板交期、推升現貨報價，供需缺口預計延長至 2027 年底；高盛、花旗、大和將南電目標價上調至 1,222 元，看好產品組合改善與載板 ASP 動能。
items.summary_en: AI-server demand for ABF carriers continues to tighten supply, lengthening lead times and pushing spot prices higher; the supply-demand gap is now expected to extend into end-2027. Goldman, Citi, and Daiwa raised Nan Ya PCB's target to NT$1,222, citing better product mix and ASP momentum.

items.title_zh: 輝達 Vera Rubin 平台 6 月試產、7 月出貨
items.title_en: Nvidia's Vera Rubin VR platform on track — June trial, July shipment
items.summary_zh: 輝達 Vera Rubin 平台預計 6 月試產、7 月出貨北美 CSP；鴻海、廣達、緯創為主要 AI 伺服器 ODM，將直接受惠；節奏確認 2026 下半年是下一輪 AI 資本支出的轉折點。
items.summary_en: Nvidia's next-gen Vera Rubin AI platform is targeted for June trial production and July shipments to North American CSPs. Foxconn, Quanta, and Wistron, as primary AI server ODMs, are positioned to benefit; the cadence reinforces 2026 H2 as the inflection for the next AI capex wave.

items.title_zh: 台灣無人機今年外銷上看 2.5 億美元
items.title_en: Taiwan drones: exports head for US$250 mn in 2026
items.summary_zh: 東歐需求高漲、首季出口值已破 1 億美元 (捷克為最大買家)；外交部將率團赴美參展，「人才、技術、出海口」三路推進，全年外銷估達 2.5 億美元。
items.summary_en: Strong Eastern European demand has Q1 drone export value already past US$100 mn (Czech Republic is the top buyer); MOFA will lead a delegation to a US drone expo, while three policy tracks — export, training, and tech transfer — push annual exports toward US$250 mn for 2026.

items.title_zh: 金融三業 Q1 狂賺 3,710 億元創同期新高、年增 37%
items.title_en: Taiwan's three financial sectors book record Q1 profit of NT$370.997 bn (+37% YoY)
items.summary_zh: 銀行業、保險業、證券期貨投信投顧合計稅前盈餘 3,709.97 億元，年增 37.09% 創歷史同期新高。銀行業靠利差與財管手續費領跑、證券業受惠台股多頭、保險業寫近四年同期最佳。
items.summary_en: Banks, insurance, and securities/futures/SITC together earned NT$370.997 bn pre-tax in Q1 2026, the strongest first quarter on record (+37.09% YoY). Banking led on rate spread plus wealth management fees; securities benefited from the TAIEX rally; insurance posted its best first quarter in four years.

items.title_zh: 亞資專區 56 家進駐 AUM 邁向 2.4 兆元
items.title_en: Kaohsiung Asia Asset Management hub heads toward NT$2.4 tn AUM
items.summary_zh: 高雄亞資專區即將滿週年，已有 56 家金融機構獲准進駐 (銀行 21 家、壽險 6 家、投信 16 家、證券 13 家)、年中估達 60 家、AUM 衝 2.4 兆元；彭金隆將於 5/18 率隊南下視察、宣告「如果在高雄可以、何須去新加坡」。
items.summary_en: Ahead of its first anniversary, 56 institutions (21 banks, 6 insurers, 16 SITCs, 13 brokerages) have moved into the Kaohsiung zone, with the entrant count expected to reach 60 by mid-year and AUM heading toward NT$2.4 tn. FSC chair Peng Jin-lung will lead an on-site review on 5/18 to recalibrate the trial program; he pitched: "if it works in Kaohsiung, why go to Singapore?"

items.title_zh: 四公股金控加碼台積電 臺灣金 Q1 買逾 1,400 張最多
items.title_en: State-owned financial holdings load up on TSMC in Q1
items.summary_zh: 台積電 Q1 漲 13.5% 之際，公股金控 (臺灣金、第一金、兆豐金、華南金) 同步加碼；臺灣金加碼逾 1,400 張居冠，反映指數驅動與 AI 基建配置的雙重邏輯。
items.summary_en: Four public-bank holdings — Taiwan Financial, First, Mega, Hua Nan — added TSMC shares as the stock rallied 13.5% in Q1. Taiwan Financial topped the list with over 1,400 lots added, reflecting both index-driven buying and a strategic capture of AI-infrastructure exposure on the SOE balance sheet.

items.title_zh: 國人首季信用卡狂刷 1.25 兆元創同期新高
items.title_en: NT$1.25 tn credit-card spend in Q1 sets record; non-cash payments at NT$2.34 tn
items.summary_zh: 2026 年 3 月信用卡單月簽帳 4,524 億元創同期新高；Q1 累計簽帳 1.2522 兆元；非現金支付交易筆數約 22.13 億筆、金額 2.34 兆元，消費金融與電支動能延續強勁。
items.summary_en: March single-month credit card billings hit NT$452.4 bn (record for the period); Q1 cumulative billings reached NT$1.2522 tn. Q1 non-cash payments tallied ~2.213 bn transactions and NT$2.34 tn in aggregate value — consumer-finance and e-payment momentum stays firmly bullish into 2026.

items.title_zh: 4 月新台幣 REER 近九月新高 傳產出口承壓
items.title_en: NTD REER hits nine-month high — traditional exporters squeezed
items.summary_zh: 央行 4 月新台幣實質有效匯率指數 (REER) 創近九月新高，對傳統製造出口構成壓力；新台幣 5/9 收 31.429、單周強升 0.7%，匯銀人士預期央行守 31.3~31.8 元波動區間。
items.summary_en: The central bank's April real effective exchange rate (REER) index for the NTD climbed to a near-nine-month high, pressuring traditional manufacturers' export competitiveness. NTD closed at 31.429 on 5/9 after a 0.7% weekly appreciation; bank dealers see the CBC steering the band between 31.3 and 31.8.

items.title_zh: 渣打首推保單融資 與凱雷推第二檔 PE 基金搶高資產
items.title_en: Standard Chartered launches Taiwan's first policy financing for HNW clients, adds Carlyle PE fund
items.summary_zh: 渣打在台首推保單融資、成為唯一在亞資專區同時提供「保單融資 + 保費融資 + 金融資產組合融資」的外商銀行；並與凱雷再推第二檔「非證券投資信託基金性質」私募股權基金，瞄準亞資中心高資產客群管道。
items.summary_en: Standard Chartered becomes the only foreign bank in Taiwan offering the full HNW-financing stack — policy financing, premium financing, and Lombard lending against financial-asset portfolios — and is rolling out a second Carlyle-partnered private equity offering not structured as a securities-investment-trust fund. The combination targets the Asia Asset Management hub's affluent client pipeline.

items.title_zh: 台灣主動式 ETF 規模逾 6,000 億 5 月新募 8 檔
items.title_en: Active ETF AUM in Taiwan tops NT$600 bn one year after launch
items.summary_zh: 主動式 ETF 開放一年內規模突破 6,000 億元 (其中 00400A 國泰動能高息規模逾 200 億、躍居全台第五大主動 ETF)；5 月待募 12 檔中、一般與主動 ETF 占 8 檔約三分之二。
items.summary_en: A year into the active-ETF regime, AUM has crossed NT$600 bn — about NT$200 bn of which sits in 00400A (Cathay Active Momentum Dividend), now the No.5 active ETF in Taiwan. Of the 12 funds in fundraising in May, eight are general or active ETFs (≈2/3 of the pipeline).

items.title_zh: 統一「主動統一升級 50」(00403A) 5/12 掛牌
items.title_en: Uni-President's "Active 50 Upgrade" (00403A) lists 5/12, riding AI upgrade cycle
items.summary_zh: 統一投信主動式 ETF「主動統一升級 50」(00403A) 5/12 上市，聚焦台股市值前 200 大個股、主動操作搭配 AI 升級潮，定位為被動 0050 之外的另類布局工具。
items.summary_en: Uni-President Investment Trust's actively managed "Active 50 Upgrade" ETF (00403A) lists Monday 5/12, targeting Taiwan's top-200 stocks by market cap. The product is being marketed as a hybrid alternative to passive 0050 exposure, with active rebalancing to capture the AI value-chain upgrade.

items.title_zh: 野村推首檔「稀土×鈾礦×黃金」ETF 1.5 萬可布局
items.title_en: Nomura launches Taiwan's first Rare-Earth × Uranium × Gold ETF
items.summary_zh: 野村首檔戰略資產 ETF (009821-TW) 採稀土、鈾礦、黃金 1/3-1/3-1/3「333 配置」、1.5 萬元可布局，6/1-6/4 募集、6/17 掛牌；經理人定位三大戰略資產分別為 AI 晶片材料必需、核能復興受惠與地緣避險。
items.summary_en: Nomura's first strategic-resources ETF (009821-TW) bundles rare earths, uranium, and gold in a 1/3-1/3-1/3 allocation, with a minimum entry of NT$15,000. Subscription window 6/1–6/4 and listing 6/17; the manager pitches the three sleeves as "AI-chip materials necessity / nuclear renaissance beneficiary / geopolitical hedge".

items.title_zh: 0050 規模逼近 1.7 兆元、股民達 270 萬人
items.title_en: 0050 nears NT$1.7 tn AUM, 2.7 mn investors — rebalance ahead
items.summary_zh: 元大台灣 50 (0050) 規模逼近 1.7 兆元、股民達 270 萬人；週三開盤 96.05、盤中高 96.90 元；隨成分股權重洗牌進入定期審核，下一階段資金重分配將牽動權值股表現。
items.summary_en: Yuanta Taiwan Top 50 (0050) AUM is approaching NT$1.7 tn with 2.7 mn unique investors; on Wednesday it opened at 96.05 and printed a 96.90 intraday high. Constituent rebalancing is approaching as the underlying index undergoes its scheduled review — flows into the next-generation cohort will reshape large-cap performance.

items.title_zh: 海外電力能源 ETF 價量齊揚、今年漲逾 38%
items.title_en: Overseas power & energy ETFs run hot — up 38%+ YTD on AI capex
items.summary_zh: AI 資本支出帶動電力需求激增、美電力基建指數創歷史新高，海外電力能源 ETF 今年股價漲逾 38%、受益人數攀升；題材從利基轉為 AI 供應鏈核心配置。
items.summary_en: Overseas power & energy ETFs are tracking the US Power Infrastructure Index to fresh all-time highs, with YTD returns past 38% and rapid investor growth. AI capex is driving structural surge in electricity demand — the play has crossed from a niche thematic into a mainstream core for AI-supply-chain investors.

items.title_zh: 「連續受益人信託」政院跨部會達共識 僅課一次遺贈稅
items.title_en: "Continuous beneficiary trust" tax relief gets inter-agency consensus — only one estate/gift tax at inception
items.summary_zh: 政院跨部會協商達共識：「連續受益人信託」在特定期間內僅於信託成立初始課徵一次遺贈稅，突破過去每次受益人變更都需重課遺贈稅的限制；改革明確扣連亞資中心政策，為跨世代家族信託實質可行性大幅開門。
items.summary_en: A cabinet-level cross-ministry meeting reached consensus on a tax framework for "continuous beneficiary trusts": estate/gift tax would be levied only once at trust inception within a defined period, breaking the prior rule that every beneficiary change triggers new tax. The reform is explicitly tied to the Asia Asset Management Center initiative, opening the door for genuine multi-generation Taiwanese family trusts.

items.title_zh: 114 年度綜所稅長照特別扣除額調升至 18 萬元
items.title_en: Long-term care special deduction raised to NT$180,000
items.summary_zh: 自 114 年 1 月 1 日起長照特別扣除額由 12 萬元調升為每人每年 18 萬元；納稅人扶養符合衛福部身心失能條件之親屬可於本年度申報，實質減輕照顧家庭稅負。
items.summary_en: Effective tax year 2025 (filing in May 2026), the LTC special deduction rises from NT$120,000 to NT$180,000 per dependent. Taxpayers supporting family members meeting MOHW's "disability" criteria can claim the higher figure on this year's return, materially reducing tax burden for caregiving households.

items.title_zh: 網紅平台分潤所得 6/30 前補報免罰
items.title_en: Influencer income now firmly inside the tax net — amnesty window to 6/30
items.summary_zh: 財政部新訂「個人於網路發表創作或分享資訊課徵綜合所得稅作業規範」，將網紅平台分潤、業配、內容變現收入正式納入課徵框架；個人若於 6/30 前主動補報或更正可免罰，後續對社群與 OTT 收入查核力度將提升。
items.summary_en: MOF's new "Guidelines on Taxation of Personal Online Creator Income" formalize prior gray areas. Individuals receiving platform revenue-share, sponsorship, or content monetization who voluntarily file or amend by 6/30 can avoid penalties, signaling closer monitoring of social-media and OTT income going forward.

items.title_zh: 海外投資虧損抵稅三限制 報稅常見錯誤集中在「虧損怎麼扣」
items.title_en: Overseas investment losses: three limits, with errors clustered on the "how to deduct" rule
items.summary_zh: 高雄國稅局提醒：海外投資損失可從當年度海外交易所得扣除，但受三限制 (同年度、同類別、扣除上限)；申報錯誤集中於虧損扣除方式，高資產族群須留意與最低稅負制下海外所得 100 萬元門檻的配合。
items.summary_en: Kaohsiung NTB clarified that overseas investment losses can be offset against overseas trading income in the same year, subject to three limits (matching year, matching category, capped utilization). Most filer errors cluster on the deduction method — high-net-worth families with offshore brokerage accounts need to recheck how losses are matched against the minimum-tax-burden framework.

items.title_zh: 死亡前 2 年內贈與弟媳婦、朋友 算遺產嗎？
items.title_en: Pre-death gifts to in-laws & friends — when do they count as deemed estate?
items.summary_zh: 高雄國稅局援引遺贈稅法第 15 條：死亡前 2 年內贈與配偶或二親等內親屬之財產始視為遺產併計課稅；贈與弟媳婦 20 萬元、朋友 10 萬元不屬列入範圍，但傳承架構設計仍須注意相關認定。
items.summary_en: Kaohsiung NTB clarified Article 15 of the Estate & Gift Tax Act: only gifts made within two years of death to spouses or relatives within the second degree are deemed part of the estate. A NT$200,000 gift to a sister-in-law or NT$100,000 to a friend would not be added back — but practitioners should still track the related limits when designing transmission structures.

items.title_zh: 證交稅估連九紅、挑戰歷史新高
items.title_en: Securities transaction tax on a nine-month win streak — heading for new highs
items.summary_zh: 受台股指數屢創新高帶動、證交稅可望連續九個月年增、挑戰歷史新高；超徵紅利持續為財政部留下對 AI 供應鏈資本支出獎勵的政策空間。
items.summary_en: Driven by TAIEX repeatedly setting record highs, securities transaction tax revenue is poised to log its ninth consecutive month of YoY gains and challenge an all-time peak. The trend continues to fund a tax-revenue surprise that supports both fiscal headroom and asymmetric AI-supply-chain capex incentives.

items.title_zh: Fed 主席交棒倒數 參議院本週表決華許接任案
items.title_en: Fed leadership transition: Senate vote on Warsh imminent
items.summary_zh: 參議院將於本週就提名華許 (Kevin Warsh) 出任 Fed 第 17 任主席進行最終確認投票 (銀行委員會已於 4/29 黨派立場通過)；華許暗示將同步推動「降息＋縮表」、與鮑爾單一工具策略形成差異，市場正重新評估政策路徑與節奏。
items.summary_en: The Senate is set to vote this week on Kevin Warsh's nomination as the 17th Fed chair after a 4/29 banking-committee party-line approval. Warsh has hinted at running "cuts + balance-sheet runoff" in parallel, diverging from Powell's single-tool approach; markets are recalibrating both the path and the pace of policy.

items.title_zh: 高盛延後 Fed 首次降息至 2026 年底、通膨估卡 3%
items.title_en: Goldman delays first Fed cut to end-2026; inflation stuck near 3%
items.summary_zh: 高盛將首次降息預期延後至 2026 年 12 月，指能源成本轉嫁可能使核心 PCE 全年維持 3% 附近；同步將美衰退機率下調至 25%，形塑「不衰退也不急降息」格局，主張續抱優質股、留意存續期風險。
items.summary_en: Goldman pushed its first-cut call out to December 2026, citing energy cost pass-through that may keep core PCE near 3% through year-end. The bank also trimmed US recession odds to 25%, painting a no-recession-but-no-imminent-easing setup that argues for staying long quality with caution on duration.

items.title_zh: 古爾斯比：AI 不論成敗都會推升通膨
items.title_en: Goolsbee: AI lifts inflation either way
items.summary_zh: 芝加哥聯邦準備銀行總裁古爾斯比於史丹佛會議警告，低利率時代未必能回來：AI 若未提升生產力將引發停滯性通膨；若帶來生產力紅利、企業搶先擴產也將推升通膨壓力，雙路徑均削弱長期低利率論據。
items.summary_en: Chicago Fed president Goolsbee warned at Stanford that the low-rate era may not return regardless of how AI plays out: if AI fails to lift productivity, we get stagflation; if it succeeds, companies racing to build capacity will themselves push prices up. Both paths erode the case for sustained low rates.

items.title_zh: 美 4 月非農 +11.5 萬人 強於預期、失業率 4.3%
items.title_en: US April non-farm +115k — Fed gets a "no rush" report
items.summary_zh: 美 4 月非農新增 11.5 萬人 (預期約 6.2 萬人)、失業率連二月持穩 4.3%、薪資年增 3.6%；華爾街解讀為「不冷不熱」報告、消除衰退疑慮、強化 Fed 維持利率不變理由，晶片股反彈、美股開高。
items.summary_en: April non-farm payrolls rose 115k vs ~62k expected; unemployment held at 4.3% for a second consecutive month; AHE +3.6% YoY. Wall Street read it as a "Goldilocks-enough" print that removes recession fears and reinforces the Fed's reasoning to hold rates steady; chips rebounded and US indices opened higher.

items.title_zh: 台灣 4 月出口 676 億美元 創單月次高、年增 39%
items.title_en: Taiwan April exports US$67.6 bn — single-month second-best ever
items.summary_zh: 4 月出口 676 億美元、創歷史單月次高、年增 39%；確認 AI 供應鏈拉貨仍是台灣出口主軸，即便傳產面臨新台幣偏強壓力。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's April exports came in at US$67.6 bn (+39% YoY), the second-highest single-month total on record. The print confirms that AI-supply-chain pull continues to anchor Taiwan's export complex even as traditional industries face NTD strength.

items.title_zh: 加速落實對美投資 MOU 台積電擴大至 2,000 億美元
items.title_en: US-Taiwan investment MOU acceleration — TSMC commitment lifted to US$200 bn
items.summary_zh: 台灣 20 家高科技廠自主投資美國 350 億美元、台積電擴大投資至 2,000 億美元；首期信保規模 500 億美元預計 5 月底上路；國發會、經濟部首度赴美挺科技廠投資、亞利桑那州同步協助台積電用水需求。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 20 major tech companies have committed US$35 bn in autonomous US investment, with TSMC alone expanded to US$200 bn; the first US$50 bn first-phase guarantee program is targeted for end-May launch. The National Development Council and MOEA traveled to the US for the first time to back the program — Arizona will simultaneously help secure TSMC's water permits — ahead of the Xi-Trump summit.

items.title_zh: 輝達失寵 美股硬體四雄 (英特爾／超微／美光／康寧) 上演 CPU 大反攻
items.title_en: Hardware Four: Intel, AMD, Micron, Corning eclipse Nvidia in the week's run
items.summary_zh: AI 基建紅利首度從輝達擴散全產業鏈：超微與英特爾單周大漲約 25%、美光飆 37%、康寧攀升 18%；英特爾今年漲超過 200%、遠優於輝達 15% 漲幅，是 AI 資本支出回報首次明顯外溢。
items.summary_en: AI infrastructure dividends spilled across the value chain: AMD and Intel rallied ~25% on the week, Micron +37%, Corning +18%; Intel is up 200%+ YTD versus Nvidia's 15%. The rotation marks the first cycle in which AI capex returns are spreading materially beyond the GPU king.

items.title_zh: 大摩：亞洲迎 AI 超級週期、16 兆美元商機才剛起步
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley: Asia entering an AI super-cycle worth US$16 tn
items.summary_zh: 摩根士丹利亞太團隊指 AI、能源轉型、國防供應鏈韌性帶動新工業週期；預估亞洲固定資產投資將從 2025 年 11 兆美元升至 2030 年 16 兆美元，全球資料中心投資 2026–2028 年達 2.8 兆美元；漲勢才剛起步。
items.summary_en: Morgan Stanley's APAC team frames AI, energy transition, and defense-supply-chain resilience as drivers of a new industrial cycle. Asian fixed-asset investment is projected to rise from US$11 tn (2025) to US$16 tn (2030); global data-center investment over 2026–2028 totals US$2.8 tn — the upcycle, they argue, has only just started.

items.title_zh: 華爾街激辯 1999 泡沫重演 AI「窒息式修正」警告
items.title_en: Wall Street debates 1999 redux — warning of an AI "asphyxiation correction"
items.summary_zh: 高盛、《大賣空》原型貝瑞、Paul Tudor Jones 將當前 AI 狂潮比擬 1999 網路泡沫：S&P 500 連六週收漲、費半 5 個交易日暴漲 11%、看漲對看跌期權幅度近四年最高；流動性與樂觀情緒驅動下可能逼近臨界點。
items.summary_en: Goldman, "Big Short" Michael Burry, and Paul Tudor Jones publicly compare the current AI rally to 1999-style dot-com excess. SPX has set fresh records six weeks running; SOX +11% in five sessions; call/put skew at a near-four-year extreme. Critics warn liquidity- and sentiment-driven gains may be approaching a tipping point.

items.title_zh: 金價或衝 8,000 美元！德銀：央行去美元化重寫金融秩序
items.title_en: Gold heading to US$8,000? — Deutsche Bank: central banks are rewriting the order
items.summary_zh: 德銀指全球央行儲備結構正經歷數十年最深刻重組：美元占央行外匯儲備從超過 60% 降至 40%、黃金占比四年內近翻倍至約 30%、差距僅 10 個百分點；現貨黃金週五收每盎司 4,719.68 美元、單周漲 2.3%。
items.summary_en: Deutsche Bank argues global central-bank reserve composition is undergoing its deepest restructuring in decades: the USD share has fallen from 60%+ to ~40%, while gold's share has nearly doubled in four years to ~30%, narrowing the gap to just 10 percentage points. Spot gold closed Friday at US$4,719.68/oz (+2.3% on the week).

items.title_zh: 荷姆茲海峽封鎖延續 高油價成常態 美中東封鎖艦逾 20 艘
items.title_en: Hormuz blockade hangs on — high oil prices now treated as "the new normal"
items.summary_zh: 美軍中央司令部宣布逾 20 艘軍艦執行對伊朗海上封鎖、61 艘商船改變航線；布蘭特原油從 126 美元戰時高點回落但仍守 100 美元、較衝突升級前高出逾 38%；華爾街拋棄「TACO」、改瘋「NACHO」交易、視高油價為常態化特徵而非尾部風險。
items.summary_en: US Central Command says 20+ warships are enforcing the blockade against Iran, with 61 commercial vessels ordered to reroute; Brent has pulled back from its US$126 wartime high but holds above US$100, still 38% above pre-escalation levels. Wall Street has retired the "TACO" narrative for "NACHO" — pricing the blockade and elevated crude as a structural feature, not a tail risk.

items.title_zh: 習川會 5/14-15 北京登場 議題涵蓋經貿、供應鏈、科技管制
items.title_en: Xi-Trump summit set for 5/14–15 Beijing — tech-export easing in play
items.summary_zh: 中美元首本週 5/14-15 北京會談，議題涵蓋經貿、供應鏈與科技管制；輝達、蘋果等企業領袖隨行；分析師認為若會談帶來確定性、美方可能放寬科技出口管制，將提振中國出口商與科技硬體製造商。
items.summary_en: China and US leaders are scheduled to meet 5/14–15 in Beijing covering trade, supply chain, and tech-export controls. Nvidia, Apple and other executives are reportedly in the delegation; analysts see room for US tech-export easing if the summit yields clarity, with Chinese exporters and tech-hardware names the likely upside beneficiaries.

items.title_zh: 日本爆發近十年最大反戰示威 要求高市早苗辭職
items.title_en: Japan's largest anti-war protests in a decade — calls for PM Takaichi to resign
items.summary_zh: 日本爆發近十年最大反戰示威、要求首相高市早苗下台；其去年 10 月上任以來推動解除武器出口禁令、部署遠程飛彈，被視為侵蝕戰後和平體制；亞太地緣風險溢酬重新進入視野。
items.summary_en: Japan saw its largest anti-war demonstrations in nearly a decade, with protesters demanding PM Takaichi Sanae step down. Since taking office last October, she has lifted weapons-export bans and deployed long-range missiles — moves widely seen as eroding Japan's post-war pacifist framework. Regional geopolitical risk premium is back on the table.
